violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs stored above ready to consume juices in 3 door bar cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge placed raw eggs below all ready to eat items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: seaweed salad (marked 4/16) in 2 drawer under counter unit (left side, bar); and unmarked blanched mushrooms in 2 door prep.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Person in charge discarded all listed items.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: raw shell egg used for sours that are not listed on menus, but available upon customer request.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Person in charge agreed to discontinue service of all “sour” cocktails that include raw shell egg.

violations.title: Food from Approved Source
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is not from an approved food preparation/processing facility: sous-vide chicken wings were being served. This product does not appear to be from a commercial establishment or prepared in-house.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with the Law. Please provide documentation (invoice, letter, etc), from the manufacturer for this product demonstrating the product is inspected and approved by an appropriate authority. Discontinue offering this product until a determination is made.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Containers of prepared rice were being stacked in the refrigerator so that the bottom of the container on top, was being used as a cover for the container below.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. Please discontinue this practice and use proper covers from each container.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sous-vide chicken wings stored in the refrigerator were 131ºF. They were previously in a hot water bath.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Per another violation cited on this report, this product may no longer be served until its source can be determined as approved. If not approved, they may no longer be served. If approved, they must be held hot at 135ºF and above, or 41ºF and below.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: no raw or undercooked foods had an asterisk by them.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. The menus must be updated to identify which ingredients are offered raw or undercooked. This is usually done by placing an asterisk next to the ingredient (not the name of the menu item). Please update and provide a draft for review before printing to your EHS within 10 days. There must also be a statement stating the foods are served raw or undercooked.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Acidification
violations.observation: The person in charge states that acidification with vinegar is used to render the sushi rice not a time/temperature control for safety food. Therefore, a specialized processing method of food preservation requiring a variance from the Health Department is used for sushi rice.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before using food additives or adding components such as vinegar as a method of food preservation rather than as a method of flavor enhancement or to render a food so that it is not time/temperature control for safety food. Correct with 10 days by submitting a variance request and HACCP plan or by switching to time only as a public health control. WATERMARK HOTEL (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Please provide at least one food thermometer within 10 days.
